consequence_classes.A: Stop current run, preserve evidence, repair and continue task; never terminal scientific FAIL by itself.
consequence_classes.B: Reject candidate/branch only; continue legal branches; no physical threshold relaxation.
consequence_classes.C: Propagate covariance/information/weight or name uncertainty/conflict; do not stop run by itself.
consequence_classes.D: Log diagnostic and continue unless a separate Class A integrity invariant fails.

requirements.requirement: Before any bespoke solver work, reproduce the unmodified official QMT full-body advanced example and complete a bounded thin C2 adapter attempt within 60 minutes.
requirements.prestart_evidence: pinned QMT revision, MIT license, environment lock, upstream example and exact 60-minute budget
requirements.runtime_evidence: unmodified upstream output, C2 adapter diff, corrected trajectory hashes, front/side/top images, QMT diagnostics and earliest incompatibility if not completed

requirements.requirement: Canonical Fusion_Part path only; no branch, worktree, checkout copy, or raw-data copy.
requirements.prestart_evidence: resolved cwd, git worktree list, disk-growth baseline
requirements.runtime_evidence: file-access and disk-growth audit

requirements.requirement: At least 100 GB free on /mnt/nrf_ssd, 40 GB on root, projected growth no more than 5 GB.
requirements.prestart_evidence: df and projected-output manifest
requirements.runtime_evidence: final disk delta

requirements.requirement: C2 only, all ten authoritative hardware IDs exactly once, legacy aliases fail closed.
requirements.prestart_evidence: sealed identity hash and exact map comparison
requirements.runtime_evidence: per-episode identity audit

requirements.requirement: Fresh immutable metadata preselection exists before any new payload open/hash.
requirements.prestart_evidence: new seal with authority, wear, frame, anthropometry, source, config, selection and synthetic hashes
requirements.runtime_evidence: append-only access audit beginning after seal timestamp

requirements.requirement: Only raw accelerometer and gyroscope plus timing/status fields are decoded; all forbidden sources remain inaccessible.
requirements.prestart_evidence: decoder schema and forbidden-token audit
requirements.runtime_evidence: decoded-field access manifest

requirements.requirement: Wear directions remain qualitative regions/soft priors; no exact frame construction or hidden small correction lock.
requirements.prestart_evidence: source audit plus 40/55/70-degree sensitivity mutations
requirements.runtime_evidence: retained mount branches and prior contribution report

requirements.requirement: One continuous six-axis orientation state spans the entire capture; episode boundaries never reset VQF or yaw gauge.
requirements.prestart_evidence: lifecycle test and reset-path negative mutation
requirements.runtime_evidence: single filter instance/state lineage and boundary covariance trace

requirements.requirement: QMT corrected orientation and time-varying deltaFilt are consumed by factors, refinement, progressive state and viewer.
requirements.prestart_evidence: dataflow test and constant-collapse negative mutation
requirements.runtime_evidence: trajectory hashes and consumer manifest

requirements.requirement: QMT row selection is preregistered, result-independent and noise-aware; exact axis parallelism is not physical truth.
requirements.prestart_evidence: selection mutation, still-noise covariance, boundary sensitivity
requirements.runtime_evidence: all selected indices, reasons, excitation distribution and effective rows

requirements.requirement: Both knees use relevant seated raise, squat and heel-to-butt evidence; initial rest alone cannot qualify an axis.
requirements.prestart_evidence: factor-to-episode map test
requirements.runtime_evidence: per-joint episode contribution and observability report

requirements.requirement: Sensor-to-segment rotations and joint/connection lever vectors support full 3D off-axis placements.
requirements.prestart_evidence: off-axis randomized synthetic and axial-collapse mutation
requirements.runtime_evidence: fitted 3D vectors, priors, covariance and bounds

requirements.requirement: Measured geometry and uncertain landmarks are separated from fitted calibration; no invented torso/hip truth or surface-to-internal substitution.
requirements.prestart_evidence: parameter ownership inventory and anthropometry audit
requirements.runtime_evidence: used-versus-fitted parameter table with provenance

requirements.requirement: Initial still estimates only tilt, bias/noise/stillness and impossible branches; it cannot declare calibration complete.
requirements.prestart_evidence: false-initial-completion mutation
requirements.runtime_evidence: initial information rank and unresolved-state report

requirements.requirement: Global graph owns exactly nine relative headings and one pelvis yaw gauge.
requirements.prestart_evidence: topology and gauge-rank test
requirements.runtime_evidence: gauge-reduced information spectrum

requirements.requirement: Multiple physically legal branches survive until cumulative evidence prunes them.
requirements.prestart_evidence: full-circle/multibranch synthetic and order permutations
requirements.runtime_evidence: branch lineage, weights, eliminations and reasons

requirements.requirement: Physical feasibility filters candidates before residual ranking; invalid lower-cost candidates cannot displace legal ones.
requirements.prestart_evidence: lower-cost-invalid negative mutation
requirements.runtime_evidence: all candidate costs and physical verdicts

requirements.requirement: One persistent chronological progressive state retains all complete episodes; no per-action profiles or stitching.
requirements.prestart_evidence: state-lineage test, reset/stitching mutations and order permutations
requirements.runtime_evidence: append-only prefix checkpoints with a single state identity

requirements.requirement: Progress is information/uncertainty/branch/physical/held-out based and may decrease on conflict; never count-based.
requirements.prestart_evidence: fake-progress and conflicting-evidence mutations
requirements.runtime_evidence: component curves and named decreases

requirements.requirement: Static correlation and common bias uncertainty enter covariance/information; samples are not treated as independent votes.
requirements.prestart_evidence: correlated-noise synthetic and effective-sample-size test
requirements.runtime_evidence: block covariance and effective-row reports

requirements.requirement: Every predicate is classified A/B/C/D; no local stochastic threshold terminates the task.
requirements.prestart_evidence: complete predicate inventory with no unclassified executable gate
requirements.runtime_evidence: predicate outcomes and applied consequences

requirements.requirement: Independent synthetic covers human variability, off-axis mounts, drift/noise/degeneracy/order and all mandatory negative mutations.
requirements.prestart_evidence: model-independence audit and complete qualification artifact
requirements.runtime_evidence: synthetic hash bound into preselection

requirements.requirement: Stage iteration/wall/multistart/worker budgets are fixed before execution; failure triggers causal pivot, not blind restart or relaxation.
requirements.prestart_evidence: effective budget table and timeout test
requirements.runtime_evidence: convergence/wall traces and causal pivot record

requirements.requirement: Final progressive state agrees with a fresh chronological all-episode batch and held-out evidence.
requirements.prestart_evidence: synthetic equivalence test and preregistered comparison units
requirements.runtime_evidence: progressive-versus-batch parameter and uncertainty report

requirements.requirement: Direct raw-path fixed-geometry FK viewer uses no IK, repair or rebase and exports front/side/top views.
requirements.prestart_evidence: viewer dataflow and forbidden-rescue test
requirements.runtime_evidence: trajectory/config hashes and image paths

requirements.requirement: Worker and independent monitor inspect actual initial, upper, lower, squat and final images; gross invalidity forces diagnosis and continuation.
requirements.prestart_evidence: required-frame manifest
requirements.runtime_evidence: human findings tied to image hashes

requirements.requirement: Final PASS/INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL is evidence-backed and distinguishes implementation failure from scientific failure.
requirements.prestart_evidence: deliverable schema validation
requirements.runtime_evidence: hashes, access firewall, tests, synthetic, curves, parameters, conflicts, views and disk delta
